_meta.indication: Diagnostic radiopharmaceutical indicated for use in the detection of primary or metastatic pheochromocytoma or neuroblastoma as an adjunct to other diagnostic tests

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter, multinational Phase 3 scintigraphy study
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects with known or suspected neuroblastoma or pheochromocytoma (100 neuroblastoma, 151 pheochromocytoma; 154 adults, 97 pediatric)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Sensitivity and specificity of the central blinded read of the I-123 MIBG scans in detecting or ruling out active tumor versus a standard of truth
pivotal_trials.n: 251 subjects dosed; 211 in the diagnostic efficacy population (standard of truth available)
pivotal_trials.result: Planar imaging sensitivity point estimates 0.80 / 0.77 / 0.79 and specificity 0.77 / 0.73 / 0.69 across the three blinded readers; the prespecified criterion (lower CI limit >80%) was not met

key_safety: No serious adverse reactions were observed in the clinical study of 251 patients; the most common adverse reactions (dizziness, rash, pruritus, flushing, injection site hemorrhage) each occurred in <1% of patients and were mild to moderate (isolated occurrences, ≤2 patients); serious hypersensitivity reactions have been reported
target_moa: Iobenguane is structurally similar to norepinephrine and is taken up by the NE transporter in adrenergic nerve terminals, accumulating in adrenergically innervated tissues and in tumors derived from the neural crest; labeling with iodine 123 enables scintigraphic imaging

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the product is a member of the class of diagnostic radionuclide-labeled iobenguane products and did not pose unique concerns

description.text: Added indication for scintigraphic assessment of myocardial sympathetic innervation (H/M ratio) in NYHA class II/III heart failure patients with LVEF < 35%

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for an additional indication of scintigraphic assessment of sympathetic innervation of the myocardium by measurement of the heart to mediastinum (H/M) ratio of radioactivity uptake in patients with New York Heart Association (NYHA) class II or class III heart failure and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < 35%.

basis.text: Designated for priority review due to CMC considerations — a public health advantage in having a standardized product available across the US manufactured to FDA guidelines; submitted as a 505(b)(2) application

citations.quote: With the I-131-MIBG serving as a reference compound and with its European production experience, the sponsor, GE Healthcare, has submitted the NDA for I-123-MIBG (AdreView) as a 505(b)(2) application. The application has been designated for a Priority review due to the CMC considerations in that there is a public health advantage in having available across the US a standardized product manufactured according to the FDA guidelines.

summary.text: AdreView (Iobenguane I-123) was submitted by GE Healthcare as a 505(b)(2) NDA and received a priority review based on CMC/public-health considerations; the sponsor had previously obtained Orphan Drug designation for I-123 iobenguane sulfate. It was approved in the first review cycle without referral to an advisory committee, and no post-marketing commitments or requirements were needed.
